# ROADEF/EURO challenge 2012 — official final results (per-instance objectives)

Source: `ROADEF Final Results.xlsx`, challenge organizers' final standings
(https://roadef.org/challenge/2012/en/results.php). Each cell is the total
objective cost (lower is better) that the team's final submission achieved on
that instance under the challenge rules (300 s per instance, 2012 hardware).
`initial` is the cost of the given initial assignment. Empty cells (—) mean
the team did not reach that stage. The b_* instances are the qualifier-size set;
the x_* instances are the final set (their files are not shipped in this
environment). These numbers are a sense of scale for what strong 2012 teams
achieved in 300 s — later publications report better values on several
instances.
